    IPHONE HOME-SCREEN APP

    Give the arena its own screen.

    1. Open this game in Safari.
    2. Tap Share (the square with an upward arrow), then Add to Home Screen.
    3. Leave Open as Web App enabled if shown, then tap Add.
    4. Open Stickman Smash from its new Home Screen icon.

    Launching that icon removes Safari’s address and tab bars. Solo play works offline after the app has loaded online once; rooms need internet.
